text: Noxious Slimes are level 34-35 elite oozes that can be found in Maraudon.

__NOTOC__ Nus is a draenei first aid trainer located in the Crystal Hall in the Exodar. She is caring for Duumehi and Ereuso. Occassionally a Worker wil bring her some Conjured Bread courtesy of Edirah. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
__NOTOC__ Nurguni is a draenei trade goods vendor located in the Seat of the Naaru in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
Nula the Butcher is a Mag'har orc found at Garadar in Nagrand. Nula was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Nuramoc is a rare mob chimaera that spawns in Netherstorm. It flies relatively high along one of two patrolling paths.
__NOTOC__ Oakun is a draenei quest giver located at the Sha'tari Base Camp in Terokkar Forest.
Nubless Pacifier can be found from enemy faction players' corpses in Alterac Valley.

Nuji Kodosbreath is a dwarven steamwarrior and Tinker. He attacked a camp of trolls and orc raiders. After having neutralized the gaurd on duty, he send his forces of high elves and steamwarriors, to push the Horde forces back into a trap. Dirtworm crews dug a pit under the Horde troops. Gnomish helicopters then covered the pit with nets, while tinkers staked net in place. They ended up catching sixty orc prisoners for interrogation.
__NOTOC__ Noxious Shredders are wind serpents found in central Dustwallow Marsh.
Nugget Slugs are quest items found within buckets of tools around the Sludge Fen in the Northern Barrens.

__NOTOC__ Number Two is a gorilla spawned for Decoy!, part of the Blue Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. This is a standard tank-and-spank fight and can be safely completed with 3-4 people. At level 70, you can probably solo him.
Numa Cloudsister is a level 1 tauren shaman located just inside the Slave Pens of Coilfang Reservoir. She is part of the Midsummer Fire Festival storyline to interfere with Ahune's summoning.

Now, When I Grow Up... is part of the Shattrath Children's Week quest chain for the Horde. Both Now, When I Grow Up... and Time to Visit the Caverns must be completed before the next quest is offered.
Oathstone refers to two different and seemingly unrelated kinds of objects associated with dragons.
An Oath Cry is a loud, deep, furious cry that could be heard from a long distance. This was a serious shout that brought all orc clan members to the caller.

Nozzlerust Supply Runner is a goblin located in the northern reaches of the Dragon Wastes, just south of Coldwind Heights and the Kor'kron Vanguard in the Dragonblight. He failed in his attempt to bring a pack of explosives from Nozzlerust Post to the east to Angrathar the Wrathgate apparently because of the harpies at Coldwind Heights.

Nozzlerust Post is a trading post north of Galakrond's Rest, near the Crystal Vice in the Dragonblight. Several goblins, including a merchant who can repair, inhabit the area and offer various quests. They do trade and services with various factions and settlements in Dragonblight. There are several vehicles and huts at the post and according to one woman, the Coldwind harpies constantly raid their supplies.
Oath Signet is a quest reward from: *Leave Nothing to Chance *All Hail Roanauk!

.]] Oacha'noa, the goddess of wisdom, is a kraken-like sea-goddess worshipped by the tuskarr. She can be summoned using the Pearl of the Depths at the Briny Pinnacle in the Dragonblight for the quest Conversing With the Depths.
Nurtured Penguin Egg is a reputation reward; you must be with the Kalu'ak to buy it from the following vendors for : * in Dragonblight * in Howling Fjord
Nurse Applewood is a Forsaken bandage trainer found in Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.

Noxious Stings is a Hunter talent in the Survival tree, you will need to spend 23 points in Survival to max it. Players must spend a point in the Tier 5 talent Wyvern Sting before this talent is unlocked.
Nutaaq is a tuskarr dockmaster located at Kamagua in the Howling Fjord.
Nuked from Orbit (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Flame Leviathan with 3 Orbital Defense Systems active on 25-player mode.

Now We're Cookin is part of the meta-achievement for Pilgrim's Bounty. In order to complete this achievement you will need to cook up one of every Pilgrim's Bounty dish. * Spice Bread Stuffing * Pumpkin Pie * Cranberry Chutney * Candied Sweet Potato * Slow-Roasted Turkey
Oathbinder, Charge of the Ranger-General drops from the Lich King in the 25-man version of Icecrown Citadel.

Oathbound Warders are earthen who have been summoned by the Horn of the Peaks to fight at your side by the Horn of the Peaks during the quests The Earthen Oath and Loken's Lackeys. Summoning them will dismiss your current warlock or hunter pet. The warders will remain somewhere between 60 and 90 seconds.
Nozzlepot's Outpost is a goblin-run research station built by Nozzlepot. It is located near the Sludge Fen in Northern Barrens. The goblins here have an interest in the Venture Co.'s nearby work.
Nurse Lillian is a human quest giver found in Stormwind Stockade. She sends Alliance adventurers to kill Lord Overheat and bring her his core. Before the Cataclysm, she was located outside.

__NOTOC__ Nyxondra is a black dragon found circling over the Ruins of Kargath in the Badlands. She is forced by the Red Dragon Rheastrasza to lay eggs in hopes of laying a uncorrupted black dragon egg. Later after Rhea is forced to flee, Nyxondra rouses the black dragons to kill Rhea and put an end to her plans. Nyxondra is killed over the Ruins of Kargath. She is the mother of the uncorrupted black dragon egg which later hatches Wrathion. It was later revealed that Nyxondra was in fact a sister of Onyxia and thus a daughter of Deathwing himself. Despite this, she is not listed as a relative to them in Ultimate Visual Guide, Updated and Expanded.
ON GUARD! is the buff applied to you upon equipping a Foam Sword. Strucking a player will apply the Bonked! debuff on them.
Nubly Bracers are a quest reward from The Gilneas Liberation Front.
Nub's Wand is a quest reward from The Gilneas Liberation Front.
Nubish Cloak is a quest reward from The Gilneas Liberation Front.
Noxxious Scions are tainted water elementals found in Maraudon.
Nyxondra's Eggs are located in Rhea's Camp in the Badlands, guarded by Nyxondra herself.
Nunaha Grasshoof is a level 81 tauren leatherworking supplier located at the Shrine of Aviana in the contested territory of Mount Hyjal.

Nuzo was, along with Zerit, one of two bankers located in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar. Several customers stood in line at each station. He and Zerit are not present after the Goblin Slums became the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Nuri is a draenei guild vendor located at the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield.
Nozzlepot Leggings are a quest reward from The Escape (Horde).
__NOTOC__ Nozzlepot is a goblin quest giver located at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens. He's the leader of the outpost, which is named after him.
Oaf Lackeys can be found in the Mast Room guarding their boss Helix Gearbreaker.

Tommy Newcommer, or Nyorloth, was a Blizzard employee and Community Manager for the World of Warcraft [http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/forum/874703/ story forums]. He held the title of "Blizzard Employee" and claimed to not be a member of the Community team. An overview of the forum activity by Nyorloth can be seen [http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/search?a=Nyorloth&f= here] (EU) and [http://us.battle.net/wow/en/search?f=post&a=Nyorloth&sort=time here] (US). After hosting "Ask CDev #3: Questions!", he was apparently laid off, as implied in a Twitter post [https://twitter.com/#!/Gromweld/status/175047575492231168 here], which may relate to an [http://www.mmo-champion.com/content/2664-Message-from-Mike

Numbing Poison is a rogue class talent. The poison will increase the amount of time it takes for the victim to cast spells, along with reducing their attack speed. The concentrated form of it used with Shiv further reduces their casting speed. It is an exclusive choice node with Atrophic Poison.

Now You're Just Showing Off (Season 1) is a Legacy achievement that was obtained by defeating Epicus Maximus, Millhouse Manastorm, Disruptron Mk. 3R-Alpha and Zen'shar during the first Brawler's Guild season.
Nyshae is a Customer Service and Community MVP on the European Blizzard forums.

Now I Am the Master is an achievement for the cooking secondary profession. The Cooking School Bell is sold by Nam Ironpaw at Halfhill Market for 50 Ironpaw Tokens, but cannot be bought until To Be a Master is completed. This will require 600 cooking in each of the six Ways. After acquiring the bell, it can be used to summon Nomi, who will have a daily quest that will raise his cooking skill -- which in this case works similarly to raising reputation with members of the Tillers. The achievement will be awarded when Nomi reaches Best Friend ().
Oath-Bound Gauntlets are a world drop from level 80 - 86 Cataclysm mobs.
Now We are the Paragon is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Paragons of the Klaxxi in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance after assuming the mantle of three different Paragons.

Oathguard is an exploration achievement earned for gathering 100 Bloody Coins obtained from world PvP on the Timeless Isle while transformed after using a Censer of Eternal Agony or a Fire-Watcher's Oath. Both are obtained from , the Emissary of Ordos, on the eastern edge of the Blazing Way.
Number Five Is Alive is an achievement earned for all the five non-player characters survived the Lion's Landing scenario.

After killing the Anubisath mobs in Ahn'Qiraj and Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, a Small Obsidian Chunk or Large Obsidian Chunk falls to the ground and is minable. You need 305 mining to mine it. The chunks give obsidian shards, or other gems, and scarabs. Prior to the Burning Crusade expansion, the mining skill cap was 300. A mining skill of 305 could be obtained by getting the +5 mining enchant. This was often done on a pair of low-quality gloves which are equipped only to mine the ore. A goblin engineer can also make a Goblin Mining Helmet which provides +5 Mining. With the release of the game's expansions, it is now possible to obtain 305 mining without the use of extra bonuses.

Another reason is the immunity of fire elementals to fire and water elementals to water spells. Object Oriented Programming (OOP) is a relatively new concept (compared to procedural programing) which allows code to become "objects." These objects can be duplicated, extended, and in some languages, be converted between relatives. Object Oriented Programming also allows for programmers to maintain organization in their programs. This is especially vital in WoW addons, as all addons share the same execution environment and thus can conflict if poorly organized.
